scholarshipText: Horizon STEM Scholarship — $5,000 for full-time undergraduates majoring in computer science or engineering at an accredited US university. Minimum GPA 3.2. US citizens or permanent residents. Requirements: a 500-word essay on a technology that will change your community, one letter of recommendation, and an unofficial transcript. Deadline: December 15, 2026.
